name: Anton and Figtree
summary: A heavy condensed display face over a friendly geometric sans, for short headlines and big numbers.
description: Anton and Figtree is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Anton for headings with Figtree for body text. Anton is a heavy condensed display face that fits a large headline or figure in a narrow measure; Figtree is an open, geometric sans that stays readable in lists, tables and charts. Suits launches, campaigns and results decks with short titles.
